notes.title: April Progress Update Part II - Build 1.0.18
notes.content:
Hello again! Ready for the preview part II of our upcoming update? We’ll be focusing on slot machines in this one.

First off, we’ve got a brand new streamlined and recolored UI that we’re really happy with. In addition, we’ve added bet lines to add some dynamism to item collection. And for that item collection, all of the basic Rosenvale forage slot machines and items will now be in game – that means all 52 minerals and 64 fish (split between freshwater and saltwater) can now be collected.
Here’s a look at the new UI:

[previewyoutube=wg7D2MxVzYA;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve packed all of the bonus boxes into view now (instead of just having two) and have added paytable and payline information for each slot machine; this will help keep play time concise and fast-paced. In addition, all ‘lose’ symbols have been removed (symbols that when matched have no reward) and have rebalanced return and probability rates.

Another big addition is the livestock ‘pregnancy button’ located on livestock machines. This will allow you to try for pregnancy (with the help of a pregnancy token purchased from Hugo). But more on this below.

The biggest change of all, however, comes with the addition of bet lines for every machine! Cost per bet line varies per machine type, but the center payline is always free. This allows you to continue to play each machine as desired, but you may need to pay a little out of pocket to increase your odds of returns.

[previewyoutube=NbTRemRQ2dc;full][/previewyoutube]

Back to animal pregnancy, you can now expand your ranch naturally rather than through just purchasing new animals. Well, sort of naturally. You’ll need to buy a pregnancy token from Hugo first to be able to play the chance game that will determine a successful pregnancy. New babies can be normal colors or a single special color (at the moment) if you’re lucky. Take a look at the process here:

[previewyoutube=Qq2FN3x5Kko;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve added in some new slot machines, too!

There are now material slot machines, new sprites for the fishing machines, and a tidal pool machine where you can catch non-fish like shrimp, oysters, and clams. Unfortunately, to build new structures and to make upgrades, you’ll need to purchase materials from Sasha as the crafting system to refine materials isn’t in place yet. You can always save up materials for later refinement, though!

We’ve added the full range of fishing rods you can purchase as you’ll need them to play all of the fishing machines. The machines will be split into each type of fish you can catch: tiny, small, medium, large, and extra large; and you’ll need an appropriate fishing rod to play each.

[previewyoutube=2t0jYPUWsTQ;full][/previewyoutube]

There will also be three coin slot machines in the back of the pub if you want to try raising income through straight gambling rather than foraging. Bet lines for those are set at 1 gold coin, 5 gold coins, and 25 gold coins for the high rollers. We’re having a lot of fun with these machines and hope you will, too.

[previewyoutube=-pZm16UfvfE;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally, we’ll be releasing a demo once this update clears the beta process and is posted to the main branch. We’re really excited about it and hope that, if you haven’t purchased the game already, you’ll take a look at it.


Thanks for sticking with us throughout this process (and this long, long post, ha ha). We’ll be posting an updated roadmap alongside the demo, so stay tuned for that.

See you again soon!

notes.title: April Progress Update - Build 1.0.18
notes.content:
Hello again!

Sorry for the radio silence the past couple of months, but we’ve been hard at work on a BIG update. It’s still some time away from posting to beta, but we wanted to check in and highlight a few of the major changes that are on the way! There’s so much to look at, though, we need to split the preview into two posts – here’s Part I.

First up is our color scheme redesign. The slot interface UI has gotten a facelift and new, more exciting color scheme (more on that in Part 2). But in changing that, we needed to pump some more life into surrounding the surrounding environment! So we’ve updated the seasonal colors to better match the neon scheme. We hope you’ll like it!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/557067a0999059cc0598e50c12b89c70e1facae7.png[/img]

We think that the new buildings you can buy from Sasha look great against the new colors, too. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/10863c4997ddc681dabc7cf304555b070b7a48ec.png[/img]

You will now be able build cellars, along with shacks, barns, chicken coops, and upgraded houses! The default house will be replaced with a tiny house that you can upgrade 3 times total. You can also change the appearance of pre-existing buildings, move them around, and demolish them.

[previewyoutube=nvR9uEYBDzg;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=hRg5Wqirswk;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve also updated the shipping bin for better ease of access – now you can transfer items in and out if you change your mind on a sale. You can also easily see how much you’re going to make on each day’s shipment. (See a preview of the new shipping bin in the furniture video later in this post.)

The shipping bin upgrade comes along with initial storage offerings: chests, crates, barrels, and  refrigerators. Use chests, crates, and barrels to store anything you like (except for livestock); and use refrigerators and barrels stored in cellars to hold perishables and keep them from spoiling!

Finally, for Part I of our preview, we have a basic selection of furniture to fill your new buildings (with more to come)! You can buy or commission furniture from Sasha from 3 collections: Basic Furniture (no nonsense furniture that can be found anywhere), Basic Rosenvale Furniture (rustic furniture with a Rosenvale aesthetic), and Comfort Rosenvale Furniture (more homey aesthetics); as well as a large assortment of décor and standalone pieces

[previewyoutube=Cq4L-k1SoGE;full][/previewyoutube]

Buy and collect furniture, wallpaper, flooring, and more to decorate your home to suit your style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/72a6fe0a050be4fe11f4ce5843e084ea77080a74.gif[/img]

That’s it for now – hope you guys enjoyed this little preview. Next time we’ll be looking at the new slot UI, some new slot machines (including the long-awaited cows and sheep), and more!

See you soon! 😊

notes.title: Build 1.0.17 Update
notes.content:
Hello, everybody! We’re ready to push the initial relationship content into the main branch. In case you missed it in the Beta update announcement, here’s what’s going to be in the new update:

[list]
[*]Interior locations – resident homes, shops, Flower Palace, and Flower Temple 1st Floor
[*]Resident schedules – residents will move in between scenes according to their own unique weekly schedules
[*]Zoom feature – you can now zoom in and out
[*]Initial friendship relationship system – gain friendship levels with residents up to level 3
[list]
[*]Each resident relationship level will coincide with a special cut scene to help you get to know that character a little bit better
[*]Once you reach friendship level 3 for each resident (the blue smiley face), you can get a look into their homes for a glimpse into their lifestyles, likes, and dislikes
[/list]
[/list]

Upcoming next in the beta branch will be the building system, material foraging, and an additional livestock sampling.

Player house upgrades are locked until we implement the furniture and crafting systems (up next on the docket), but you will be able to start building and upgrading coops, barns, cellars, and shacks (provided you have enough materials and money).
 
Here we have a small barn being built…
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/20badd84dcd0458cba1b91a77978a91b89fb35b7.png[/img]
And a medium barn being upgraded to a large barn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/eee9bc501e4e59cb33fb9b0efa4034376f0113d3.png[/img]

Fill in your coops with a redesign of the chickens – available initially in three different colors (with many more to follow): 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/370f4117cd3c6a36cb29b8721d354c6f6b908148.png[/img]

And use your barns to house sheep and cows! Sheep will provide wool for later crafting and cows provide milk for energy boosts or cooking.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/cfde676cb1804d0e5058a58f9e9fbdf57173cbaa.png[/img]


We’re so excited for all the new content we’ve got coming down the line in the next two months! Thanks for reading, as always, and we’ll see you soon with even more additions to share!

notes.title: Beta Branch is Live!
notes.content:
Happy Saturday!

We've pushed the beta branch to public for anyone that would like to opt in. We'll skip the change list for  now, and just do a quick mention of the major changes you'll see there:

[list]
[*]Resident schedules are now in place - residents will move between locations according to their weekly schedules
[*]Friendship levels can now be earned with residents - give them gifts to increase or decrease their affections
[*]Friendship cutscenes have been implemented up to Level 3 (Level 5 is the max) - view two cutscenes per resident; at Level 3, gain access to further residence areas
[*]Flower Palace and Flower Temple implemented - the Flower Temple is walkable but no foraging right now (we will be adding location-specific slot machines at a later date)
[*]Lots of graphical and optimization changes and upgrades 
[/list]

We'll be using the beta branch to push new additions until we're sure they're ok to go up on the main game. If you don't mind a few bugs, check it out to see the new content sooner.

Hope you enjoy it! Have a great weekend, all! :)

notes.title: State of the Game - End of Apr 2024
notes.content:
Hello again, everyone! Hope you are all doing well. 😊

We aren’t able to provide the update that we were hoping for before the Farming Fest starts (April 29), BUT we have a lot of the foundations built and will be rolling out content in the next few months. 

Here’s a look of what to expect from us in that time:

[h3]1. Relationships and Relationship Events[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players will be able to build friendship and romance levels (as applicable) for residents. Each new friendship level will have a special cutscene per resident.
[/list]
[h3]2. Buildings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players will be able to place new buildings on their property, upgrade or delete existing buildings, or move existing buildings.
[*] Buildings will include houses, cellars, storage shacks, barns, and chicken coops.
[*] With new barns come new livestock – cows and sheep in particular.
[/list]
[h3]3. Furniture[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players will be able to fill their new houses and shacks with furniture to help the buildings feel more ‘homey’.
[*] Furniture will be able to be purchased or built from recipes bought from merchants or found in the wild.
[/list]
[h3]4. Crafting[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players can use existing ingredients to produce goods that will sell for a higher price than their base components.
[*] Craft specialty gifts for NPCs that will provide an extra boost of friendship or romance.
[*] Craft food, furniture, décor, clothing, and more!
[*] Find recipes in the wild – either in the world or won from slot machines!
[/list]
[h3]5. Festivals[/h3]


These are only the main content points we’re aiming for. Additional updates will also contain lots of other little things, like player avatar customization, new places to explore, new slot machines to play, and added interactivity with the world of Reel Life.

As always, we appreciate your patience and hope you’ll really enjoy the new gameplay that’s just around the corner! 


Thanks for sticking with us,

The Bad Genes Productions team

notes.title: State of the Game - 31 Jan 2024
notes.content:
Hello, all! 

We are working on pushing an update this week, but we wanted to talk a little about the state of the game as of the end of the first month.

We’re still pushing little things (this week’s update will include most interiors, lighting, and some slot adjustments) but are prioritizing our time in order to push out as much content as possible by early and mid-April. Our goal is to inject as much ‘stuff to do’ into the game in as little time as possible.

There’s been a little shuffling around of order on the roadmap, but here’s what [b]we’re aiming to get added to the game within the next two months[/b]: 

[h2]Character Customization
[/h2]

Choose your gender, skin color, eye color, hair style, hair color, and starting outfit.

With character customization will come clothing that can be bought, crafted, and switched out whenever you want.

[h2]Basic Crafting and Storage[/h2]

Crafting machines and work benches will be implemented with a basic selection of recipes.

Crafting machines are automatic crafters that take one or more inputs to create one or more outputs (e.g., putting 5 apples in a dehydrator will make 1 dried fruit item). 

We don’t want to talk about each machine here (we’ll do that when they’re added), but you’ll be able to craft things like:

[list]
[*] Baking ingredients (flour, oil, butter, sugar)
[*] Cooking ingredients (mayonnaise, sour cream, jams and jerkies)
[*] Food items (milkshakes, ice cream, juice, yogurt, pickled goods, alcohols)
[*] Materials used for crafting (ingots, glass, lumber, yarn, fabrics)
[/list]
Work benches will have a slightly more in-depth crafting system and a list of recipes to choose from. Use work benches to craft your own furniture, clothing, and bouquets.

Some of these craftable goods will best be used in further crafting or cooking, for giving as gifts, or for making money.

With the crafting system will come storage capabilities and item expiration (for perishables). Food, produce, and flowers will go bad by a certain time if not stored in a cool, dry place - like a refrigerator or in a pine barrel in your cellar.

[h2]Buildings
[/h2]

From the carpenter shop, you will be able to build, upgrade, move, and demolish buildings.
Some of the buildings that will be available are:

[list]
[*] Player Houses – in tiny, small, medium, and 3 large configurations
[*] Chicken Coops
[*] Barns
[*] Shacks (use for crafting machinery and chests if you are low on space, for example)
[*] Cellars (best used for perishable storage and crafting machinery)
[/list]
[h2]Furniture
[/h2]

All of these new buildings are going to start out empty. Fill them with moveable and removeable furniture in a grid-based system.

Furniture will not be locked to specific areas within each building, so if you want a house filled with nothing but toilets, you are free to do you.

Furniture can be placed inside buildings or around your farm – provided there’s enough space.

With the advent of a moveable and removeable bed, you will also be able to sleep and save at the city inn or hamlet hunting lodge if you don’t have a bed in your house.

[h2]Relationships and Relationship Events
[/h2]

You will finally be able to give gifts to residents and increase (or decrease) your friendship and relationship levels with each.

Drag items onto the friendship gift box to affect their friendship levels or onto the romance gift box (only available with romanceable residents) to affect their romance levels.

With each friendship level gained (up to a maximum of 5), there will be an opportunity to view a resident cutscene. While they vary from resident to resident, cutscenes will include one or more of the following:

[list]
[*] More information about the resident and/or their backstory
[*] The opportunity to further increase or decrease affection
[*] A special gift!
[/list]
Residents will also start moving around the world of Reel Life, so you might need to check the map from time to time until you get used to their schedule.

Any remaining interiors will also be added to the game (resident home areas, the Flower Palace, the Flower Temple).



We’re really excited about all the new stuff coming down the pipeline and will be working at supersonic speed to get it out, so keep checking back for updates!

The goal is to keep updating with new info as we progress, but updates and posts might be irregular for a while. As always, thank you for your patience as we continue to add more to the game.


Thanks for playing! 😊

notes.title: We're Live!
notes.content:
Features are currently quite limited, but we’ll be working hard on getting updated content out to you as fast as we can! Our initial working build will let you get a feel for the game and its characters while stockpiling funds to use in future updates.

We plan to publish monthly communications to keep you updated on our progress, but most of our time and effort will be spent pumping out additional content and features. Some updates will have small aesthetic changes, while others will have big additions to the world.

We ask that you please be patient with us as we introduce content, adjust in-game systems (payouts, items costs, etc.), and iron out any bugs.


Here is our (conservatively estimated) roadmap for the remaining big features of the base game:


[b]Q1 2024
[/b][list]
[*] Interiors
[*] Moving NPCs
[*] Relationship System (gain friendship and romance, give gifts)
[*] Eight Holidays (and their appropriate festivals)
[*] Relationship Events
[*] Player Customization
[/list]

[b]Q2 – Q3 2024
[/b][list]
[*] Build, Upgrade, and Decorate your Farm and House (building and furniture placement)
[*] Refinery and Crafting Systems
[/list]

[b]Q4 2024 – Q1 2025
[/b][list]
[*] Advanced Slot Systems
[*] Marriage and Divorce (children might be added in an update after the final build)
[*] Mail System (receive and send letters and packages)
[*] Dating System
[*] Advanced Gambling Systems (relationships, etc.)
[/list]

[b]Q2 2025 +
[/b][list]
[*] Monster Battles
[*] Monsters in the World Environment
[/list]

[b]Q3 2025 +
[/b][list]
[*] Quality of Life and Aesthetic Upgrades
[/list]


Of course, we’re hoping that we’ll be able to push these updates out much sooner than the roadmap estimates, but please remember that we are a two-person team, with one person doing the programming and the other person doing everything else.

Again, we thank you for your patience and would love to hear your feedback! We’ll be using the Steam discussion boards for bug reporting (or you can use our in-game bug report feature), but we’d also like to know your impressions on the world, its residents, and the gameplay. Any discussion of slot mechanics, payouts, HUD layout, movement, and so on are also very welcome!


[b]Thank you sincerely for your purchase and support. 
[/b]


[h2]Now, have fun and good luck![/h2]
